On the morning of the 27/10/41 Colonel Tao Sih
Sung came to Chengtu Road Station with the D.O. "A"
Division and was allowed to interview the two arrested
men. He took full particulars of the case and names
etc., of the arrested men and their absconded accomli-
ces. He stated he would endeavour to have those
accomplices arrested and recover the remainder of the
stolen property.

Since their arrest the two accused have been
further questioned but they deny having been concerned
in any other offences and nothing further has so far
been found against them. However, they admit having
given false names when arrested. Their proper names
are 1st accused - Sung Shih Yoong (孫雪榮) and 2nd
accused - Woo Yoeng King (胡容耕).

Examination of their finger-prints revealed that
the 1st accused had two previous convictions for
gambling and is wanted on Circular Order of Arrest No.
576 for Execution of Court Order - Fined $30 or 30
Days Detention. Louza Station No. 50W/39.

The 2nd accused had no previous convictions but
had been previously arrested on the 7/10/41 by West
Hongkew Detectives in connection with T.I.R. 1383/41
W.H., Armed Highway Robbery but had not been charged.

1941年10月25日至1941年10月27日。            侦探办公室。

1941年10月27日上午，陶锡松（Tao Sih Sung）上校偕同“A”区侦探长来到成都路巡捕房，获准讯问两名被捕男子。他详细记录了案情、被捕者姓名及其在逃同伙的姓名等详情。他表示将尽力逮捕那些同伙，并追回剩余被盗财物。

自被捕以来，两名被告已接受进一步讯问，但他们否认参与任何其他罪行，目前也未发现针对他们的其他罪证。然而，他们承认在被捕时使用了假名。他们的真实姓名为：第一被告 - 孙雪荣（Sung Shih Yoong），第二被告 - 胡容耕（Woo Yoeng King）。

指纹比对显示，第一被告有两次赌博前科，并因第576号通缉令（执行法院命令 - 罚款30元或拘留30天）而被通缉。老闸巡捕房案卷号 50W/39。

第二被告无前科，但曾于1941年10月7日因西区虹口侦探队处理的 T.I.R. 1383/41 W.H. 号武装拦路抢劫案被西区虹口侦探逮捕，当时未被起诉。

When further questioned by A. I. Tlors, with Clerk
Wong Yung Chuan as interpreter, regarding the circumstances
of his arrest, Tang ing Yuen (1st accused) replied as fol-
lows:-

When I ran out of the pawnshop I turned east and ran
along the footpath for a distance of about four or five houses,
about 15 or 16 yards, when the foreign sergeant who was chas-
ing me called on me to stop. I did stop and turned round and
raised my hands above my head. I had no pistol in my hand
because I had put my pistol in my pocket underneath my long
gown as I ran out of the pawnshop. The foreign sergeant seized
hold of me by grasping the back of the collar of my long gown
with one hand and the other hand at my waist covering the
pocket in which I had placed my pistol. I did not fall down
and was not pushed to the ground. He pushed me along to
where the police van was standing about two houses or eight
yards west of the pawnshop and whilst on the road beside the
van he took my pistol out of my pocket and then put me in
the van.

当由翻译王荣全（Wong Yung Chuan）协助，接受助理督察 Tlors 关于其被捕情况的进一步讯问时，唐英元（第一被告）回答如下：

当我跑出当铺时，我向东转，沿着人行道跑了大约四五间房子的距离，约15或16码，这时追赶我的外籍巡佐喝令我站住。我停了下来，转过身，双手举过头顶。我手中没有手枪，因为当我跑出当铺时，我已将手枪放入长衫下的口袋里。外籍巡佐一只手抓住我长衫的后领，另一只手按在我的腰部，盖住我放置手枪的口袋。我没有摔倒，也没有被推倒在地。他推着我走到停在当铺西边约两间房子或八码处的警车旁，在路边警车旁，他从我的口袋里取出了我的手枪，然后将我放进警车内。

Enquiries by D.S.I. Elders, D.I. Ligu Tsing Ching
C.D.C. 26 and C.D.C. 363.

At about 10.20 a.m. on the 25-10-41 an armed
robbery occurred at the Hung Tung Pawnshop, 1295
Avenue Edward VII when four male Chinese two of
whom were armed with pistols, stole a quantity of
watches, finger-rings etc., total value $2,601.00
and decamped while a fifth accomplice waited nearby
with a hire-car in which they intended to escape.
The inmates raised an alarm and a party of Police
who were passing the scene at the time, responded
and effected the arrest of two of the robbers,
seized one pistol and recovered part of the stolen
property and brought all to the station at 10.30a.m.
when enquiries were conducted by the above detectives.

Enquiries revealed that five male Chinese had
been concerned in the robbery, including the two
men arrested. Three of them, including one of
those arrested (1st named) are soldiers attached to
the 13th Division in Minghong. One of them (not
arrested) is a soldier of the same division attached
to the Shanghai office of the division at No. 9
Hung Nyih Li (洪業里) off Yu Yuen Road, C.O.L. while
the other man who was arrested (2nd named) is an
ex-soldier of the same division who resides in
Minghong.

The three men stationed in Minghong, together
with their friend the ex-soldier left their station
without leave and arrived in Shanghai at about

由侦探副督察 Elders、侦探督察李国清（Ligu Tsing Ching）、刑事侦缉队长26号及刑事侦缉队长363号进行调查。

1941年10月25日上午10时20分左右，爱多亚路1295号鸿通（Hung Tung）当铺发生武装抢劫案，四名中国男性（其中两人持手枪）盗走一批手表、戒指等物，总价值2,601.00元，随后逃窜，而第五名同伙则在附近守候一辆他们打算用来逃跑的出租车。店内人员发出警报，当时路过现场的一队警察作出反应，逮捕了两名劫匪，缴获一把手枪并追回部分赃物，于上午10时30分将所有人和物带回巡捕房，随后由上述侦探展开调查。

调查显示，共有五名中国男性参与抢劫，包括两名被捕者。其中三人（包括第一名被捕者）是驻扎在闵行的第十三师士兵。其中一人（未被捕）是同师驻上海办事处的士兵，办事处位于哥伦比亚路（C.O.L.）愚园路旁的洪业里9号；另一名被捕者（第二名）是该师退役士兵，居住在闵行。

驻扎在闵行的三名男子连同他们的朋友——那名退役士兵，未经许可离开驻地，于

pages.en:
1/3

5 p.m. on the 24-10-41. They wished to obtain money.
They went to the Shanghai Office of the Division where
they spent the night and then left that address toge-
ther at about 9 a.m. 25-10-41 to look for a place to
commit a robbery.

They had planned to commit robbery but not at
any particular place. They travelled by a Route No.
9 bus from Yu Yuen Road to the corner of Avenue Edward
VII and Yu Ya Ching Road where they alighted and wander-
ed around. Whilst there they met the fifth named who
was known to them and when passing the aforementioned
pawnshop, saw the show-case containing watches, rings
etc., and so decided to steal them.

The 1st and 3rd named were each armed with a
pistol.

Having decided to commit the robbery the 2nd and
5th named proceeded to the Ford Hire-car Garage on
Avenue Edward VII near the Nanking Theatre where they
engaged a hire-car, Licence No. 12289 which was driven
by chauffeur Huang Yee Sung (方裕生), Permit No. 5534.
They told the chauffeur they wished to go to the
Camidrome on Avenue du Roi Albert, F.C. and then enter-
ed the car which proceeded west along Avenue Edward VII.
pages.zh:
1/3

1941年10月24日下午5点左右抵达上海。他们希望弄到钱。他们前往该师上海办事处，在那里过夜，然后于1941年10月25日上午9点左右一起离开该地址，寻找作案地点。

他们计划实施抢劫，但尚未确定具体地点。他们乘坐9路公交车从愚园路到达爱多亚路与虞洽卿路路口，下车后四处游荡。在那里，他们遇到了认识的第五名男子，当经过前述当铺时，看到展示柜内装有手表、戒指等物，于是决定盗窃。

第一名和第三名男子各持有一把手枪。

决定实施抢劫后，第二名和第五名男子前往位于爱多亚路南京大戏院附近的福特出租车行，租用了一辆车牌号为12289的出租车，司机为方裕生（Huang Yee Sung），执照号为5534。他们告诉司机想去法租界阿尔贝特王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）的跑马厅，然后上车，车辆沿爱多亚路向西行驶。

pages.en:
1/4

On reaching Tamsui Road they told the chauffeur
to turn south and stop as they wished to pick up some
friends. The chauffeur stopped the car on the east
side of Tamsui Road about ten yards from the corner of
Avenue Edward VII.

Both men then alighted but the 5th named stayed
beside the car. The 2nd named then joined the 1st,
3rd and 4th named who were waiting near the pawnshop.

The pawnshop is located on the south side of Ave-
nue Edward VII about 15 yards east of Tamsui Road.

The 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th named then entered the
pawnshop. The 1st and 3rd named produced their pistols
with which they intimidated the nine assistants who
were present in the pawnshop at the time, telling them
not to move. The 1st named then smashed the glass
show-case with his pistol and all snatched a handful
of rings, watches etc. from the show-case and then
decamped.

The incident only took a few seconds and as the
four robbers left the shop the assistants raised an
alarm by blowing whistles.

At this time a party of Police consisting of
F.P.S. 88 Roussiyam, C.P.S. 2254 and C.P.C. 2915

到达淡水路时，他们告诉司机向南转弯并停车，因为他们想接一些朋友。司机在爱多亚路拐角以南约十码处的淡水路东侧停下车。

两人随后下车，但第五名男子留在车旁。第二名男子随即加入正在当铺附近等候的第一名、第三名和第四名男子。

当铺位于爱多亚路南侧，淡水路以东约15码处。

随后，第一名、第二名、第三名和第四名男子进入当铺。第一名和第三名男子亮出手枪，恐吓当时在当铺内的九名店员，命令他们不许动。第一名男子随后用手枪砸碎玻璃展示柜，所有人从展示柜中抓取一把戒指、手表等物后逃窜。

整个过程仅持续了几秒钟，当四名劫匪离开店铺时，店员们吹哨报警。

此时，由外籍巡佐88号 Roussiyam、华捕巡长2254号和华捕巡员2915号组成的一队警察

pages.en:
1/5

(Hawkers' Squad) were travelling west to east along
Avenue Edward VII in North Point Station Van. As
they approached Tamui Road this party observed the
four men running from the pawnshop and heard the
whistles being blown. They stopped the van at the
south-east corner of Avenue Edward VII and Tamui Road
and at once alighted.

F.P.S. 88 Roussiyian drew his pistol and blew his
whistle and then chased one of the four robbers (the
1st named) whom he saw running in an easterly direc-
tion on the south side of Avenue Edward VII with a
pistol in his hand. The F.P.S. stated he did not
open fire himself because he was afraid of hitting a
pedestrian as the footpath was fairly crowded at the
time. He overtook the man about 70 yards from the
pawnshop and when just a few paces from him the man
turned and pointed his pistol at him. The F.P.S.
kicked the pistol out of the man's hand and jumped on
him and arrested him and picked up the pistol.

Meanwhile C.P.C. 4913 followed by C.P.C. 2256
with drawn pistols chased another of the robbers (the 2nd
named) who ran to where the hire-car was parked on the
east side of Tamui Road about 10 yards south of Avenue
Edward VII. C.P.C. 4913 effected the arrest of this
pages.zh:
1/5

（小贩组）正乘坐北四川路巡捕房的警车沿爱多亚路由西向东行驶。当他们接近淡水路时，这队警察观察到四名男子从当铺跑出，并听到哨声。他们在爱多亚路与淡水路的东南角停下警车，立即下车。

外籍巡佐88号 Roussiyian 拔出手枪并吹响哨子，然后追捕四名劫匪中的一人（第一名），他看到此人手持手枪在爱多亚路南侧向东奔跑。该外籍巡佐表示，由于当时人行道上相当拥挤，他担心误伤行人，因此没有开枪。他在距离当铺约70码处追上了此人，就在离他只有几步远时，那人转身用枪指着他。外籍巡佐踢飞了那人的手枪，扑在他身上将其逮捕，并捡起了手枪。

与此同时，华捕巡员4913号紧随其后，华捕巡员2256号也拔枪追捕另一名劫匪（第二名），此人跑向停在淡水路东侧、爱多亚路以南约10码处的出租车旁。华捕巡员4913号在此人

man just as he reached the off-side of the car which
was headed south.

At this time, the 5th named who had been waiting
at the car; ran away from the near side of the car in
a southerly direction along Tamsui Road and escaped.
The C.P.C. states he saw this man but was unable to
stop him because he was fully occupied with the man he
arrested, and the C.P.C. who was evidently a bit slow
in following the C.P.C. stated he did not see this

After effecting the arrest of the two robbers the
Police Party put them in the van and brought them to

to drive his car to the station also.

The pistol seized is an automatic pistol, No.
68358. It contained a magazine and five rounds of

When searched, the 1st named was found to have
three wrist-watches in his possession which he had

The 2nd named, when searched, was found to have
three wrist-watches, eighteen finger-rings and two
ear-rings in his possession which had also been stolen

1/6

刚到达车头朝南的汽车外侧时将其逮捕。

此时，一直在车旁等候的第五名男子从汽车近侧沿淡水路向南逃跑并逃脱。该华捕巡员称他看到了此人，但由于忙于处理他逮捕的那名男子而无法阻止他，而显然跟随稍慢的另一名华捕巡员称他没有看到这名其他人。

逮捕两名劫匪后，警察小队将他们放入警车，并指示出租车司机也将车开往巡捕房，随后将他们带回巡捕房。

缴获的手枪是一支自动手枪，编号68358。内含一个弹夹和五发子弹，缴获时已上膛。

经搜查，在第一被告身上发现了三只他从当铺偷来的手表。

经搜查，在第二被告身上发现了三只手表、十八枚戒指和两只耳环，这些也是从当铺偷来的

pages.en:
1/7

from the pawnshop.

The total value of the property stolen is $2,631.00.
Total value recovered $532.00.

The 1st named, when smashing the glass show-case
with his pistol sustained injuries to his right hand.
He was sent to the Police Hospital for treatment and
then brought back to the station. Doctor's certificate
reads:- Incised Wound of Finger.

The two arrested men were identified as having been
two of the four men who actually took part in the robbery
by pawnshop assistants, Woo Ts Yoong (吳子雄) and Nau
Ts Chee (盧志軒) and they also both admit being concerned.

The two pawnshop assistants were shown photographs
of recently released prisoners on Special Release No-
tices but with no useful result.

The recovered property was handed over to assistant
Woo Ts Yoong against his signature in the Detained
Property Book. He was also given a Mutual Protection
pamphlet.

The seized pistol and ammunition will be passed to
the Arms Identification Section for examination.

The nearest Police to the scene of the robbery when
it occurred would be the aforementioned police officers
pages.zh:
1/7

物品。

被盗财物总价值为2,631.00元。
追回财物总价值为532.00元。

第一名男子在用枪砸碎玻璃展示柜时右手受伤。他被送往警察医院接受治疗，随后被带回巡捕房。医生证明写道：手指切割伤。

当铺店员吴子雄（Woo Ts Yoong）和卢志轩（Nau Ts Chee）辨认出两名被捕者确实是实际参与抢劫的四名男子中的两人，且两人均承认参与此事。

向两名当铺店员展示了特别释放通知单上近期释放囚犯的照片，但未获得有用结果。

追回的物品已移交给店员吴子雄，并在扣押物品登记簿上由其签字确认。他还收到了一份《互助保护》小册子。

缴获的手枪和弹药将移交枪械鉴定科进行检查。

案发时距离抢劫现场最近的警察即为上述警员

pages.en:
1/8

who were in the station van or Avenue Edward VII about
30 yards and who responded to the alarm.

The D.O. "A" Division was informed and on his
instructions the two arrested men will not be taken
before the Court at present but detained in the Station
pending further instructions.

Information regarding the robbery was circulated.

It is to be noted that this is the second time
within a few days that soldiers of this 13th Division
have been arrested in Chengtu Road District. On the
21-10-41 four members of the division were arrested
and three unlicensed pistols seized - please see Misc.
308/41 Ch. Rd. On that occasion the arrested persons
were handed over to Colonel Tao Shih Sung (陶雪生) who
expressed regret at the trouble caused. It is respect-
fully suggested that Colonel Tao be informed of this
crime and asked to take measures to arrest the other
members of the gang and recover the remainder of the
stolen property. The last named arrested man informed
detectives that he expected to be executed if arrested
by his own officers.

当时在警车站车或爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）约30码处，并对警报作出响应的人员。

我拔出装有半满子弹的手枪并吹响警哨，随后追赶四名男子中我注意到手中持有一把手枪的那一人。他沿爱多亚路南侧向东奔跑。我追赶这名持枪男子约七十码，但当我距他约八英尺时，他转身用枪指向我，但考虑到附近行人的安全，我没有开枪，而是逼近他，将其手中的枪踢落从而解除其武装，扑在他身上并将其摔倒在地，从而将其逮捕。对其人身搜查发现了三只被盗手表。

At about 10.25 a.m. 25-10-41 I was riding in the Chungtu
Road Station Police Van with C.P.C. 236 and C.P.C. 88 engaged
on hawkers squad duty, on Avenue Edward VII travelling west
to east. When reaching a point a few yards west of Tamsui

Police whistles being blown. C.P.C. 88 ordered the van to
stop at the south-east corner of Tamsui Road and Avenue Edward
VII and we all alighted. I heard police whistles being blown
by the inmates of a pawnshop located on the south-side of
Avenue Edward VII about 15 yards east of Tamsui Road and at
the same time saw a male Chinese dressed in foreign style
clothes running towards a Ford hire car ranked on the east
side of Tamsui Road about 10 yards from the Avenue Edward VII.
Thinking this man was a robber I chased him and arrested him
just as he reached the hire-car.

As I arrested this man I saw the driver of the hire-car
sitting in the driver's seat while another male Chinese was
about to enter the car from the opposite side (the near side-
car headed south). The man on the opposite side of the car,
on seeing me arrest the first man immediately ran away in a
southerly direction along Tamsui Road. C.P.C. 2236 chased
this man but the man escaped. I then instructed the driver
of the hire-car to drive his car to the station.

Meanwhile C.P.C. 88 effected the arrest of another man
who was armed with a pistol. He and the C.P.C. and myself
then brought the two arrested men to the station in the police
van.

The armed units and plainclothes groups of outside
authorities in the extra-Settlement roads area in the Western
District comprise the Japanese Gendarmerie, who are supervising
and controlling all armed organizations in that area, the
Shanghai City Government Police and Reserves, the Zao Ka Doo
Defence Corps, and the Special Service Corps of the Chung
Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National Salvation Army.
The active strength and other particulars of these armed
organizations are given in attached lists as appendices.
The following is a brief summary of the various units :-

(A) Shanghai City Government Police and Reserves

The first Chinese Police Force in the extra-
Settlement roads area in the Western District was
sponsored by the Japanese Military Police about the
end of December, 1937. This force, at the beginning of
February, 1938, became the Western District Branch Police
Bureau of the "Shanghai Da Dao City Government" which
is now known as the "Shanghai City Government."

The Western District Police Bureau is located at
92 Jessfield Road, O.O.L. The strength consists of
761 uniformed policemen and 42 plainclothes men, who
are detailed to various sub-stations and outposts.
This force was recently reinforced by 600 policemen
from the Reserve Unit in Pootung.

Particulars of this Force such as location of
sub-stations and outposts, distribution, etc. are given
in Appendix "A".

西区越界筑路区域的外国当局武装部队和便衣小组包括日本宪兵队，他们监督和控制该地区的所有武装组织，上海市政府警察和后备队，曹家渡防卫团，以及中国国民党反共救国军特别服务队。这些武装组织的现役兵力及其他详情见附录列表。以下是各单位的简要总结：-

(A) 上海市政府警察和后备队

西区越界筑路区域的第一支中国警察部队是由日本军事警察于1937年12月底赞助成立的。这支队伍在1938年2月初成为“上海大道市政府”（现称为“上海市政府”）的西区分局警察局。

西区警察局位于O.O.L.（越界筑路区）极司菲尔路92号。警力包括761名制服警察和42名便衣人员，他们被派往各个分署和哨所。这支队伍最近得到了来自浦东后备队的600名警察的增援。

police force, was established in the Zao Nan Primary
School, 93 Loo Sih Zah, off Brenan Road, O.O.L., at
the end of September, 1939. It consists of 85 men,
whose functions and other particulars are given in
Appendix "C".

(B) Japanese Gendarmerie

The Japanese Gendarmerie commenced functioning
in the extra-Settlement roads area in the Western
District about the end of November, 1937. Their Western
District Headquarters is located at 94 Jessfield Road,
O.O.L., which controls and supervises all the pro-
Japanese armed units, including the police of the
"Shanghai City Government," in that area.

The total strength of the Japanese Gendarmerie
in the extra-Settlement roads area is about 94, the
distribution is given in Appendix "B".

(C) Available Reserves

Available reserves consists of 200 Japanese
soldiers, some 650 Chinese police (in uniform and plain-
clothes), and some 80 members of a so-called self-
defence corps. The location and other particulars
are given in Appendix "C".

(D) Plainclothes Groups

The Special Service Corps of the Chung Kuo
Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National Salvation Army
(中國國民黨剷共救國軍別動總隊), headquarters at 76
Jessfield Road, O.O.L., is the only plainclothes group

(B) 日本宪兵队

日本宪兵队约于1937年11月底开始在西区越界筑路区开展活动。其西区总部设在越界筑路区极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）94号，负责控制和监督该地区所有亲日武装单位，包括“上海市政府”的警察。

日本宪兵队在越界筑路区的总兵力约为94人，分布情况见附录“B”。

(C) 可用预备队

可用预备队由200名日本士兵、约650名中国警察（身着制服及便衣）以及约80名所谓自卫团成员组成。驻地及其他详情见附录“C”。

(D) 便衣团体

中国国民党铲共救国军别动总队（中國國民黨剷共救國軍別動總隊），总部设在越界筑路区极司菲尔路76号，是已知在西区越界筑路区存在的唯一便衣团体

known to be in existence in the extra-Settlement roads
area in the Western District. For the avowed purpose
of eliminating communists and anti-Japanese elements,
this organization, under a different title, came into
being in the Western District, O.O.L., during March,
1939, and is now controlled by the Wang Ching Wei clique
under the supervision of the Japanese Military
Authorities.

This armed gang is notorious for its acts of
violence such as shootings, murders and bombings. It
is also engaged in kidnapping and extortion and
collecting intelligence on behalf of the Japanese
authorities. Its present strength is estimated at
about 1,000, the majority of whom were recruited from
the underworld fraternity and guerilla units. Some of
them are professional criminals.

Detailed particulars of this organization, such
as strength, armament, distribution, uniform and
location of branch offices, are given in Appendix "D".

A branch of this Corps, at 121 Brenan Road, O.O.L.
consisting of 125 men, has assumed the new title "The
1st Division of the Anti-Comintern Federation"
(反共協會第一師). It appears that a new armed gang
is being formed. Particulars of this branch are given
in the same appendix.

该武装团伙因枪击、谋杀和爆炸等暴力行为而臭名昭著。它还从事绑架、勒索活动，并代表日本当局收集情报。其现有兵力估计约为1,000人，其中大多数是从黑社会帮派和游击队中招募的。其中一些人是职业罪犯。

该组织的详细情况，如兵力、武器装备、分布、制服及分支机构所在地，见附录“D”。

该总队的一个分支位于越界筑路区白利南路121号，由125人组成，已采用新番号“反共协会第一师”（反共協會第一師）。看来一个新的武装团伙正在形成中。该分支的详情见同一附录。

Re arrest of Wang Ching Wei Army Officials
in possession of arms and ammunition

On the morning of August 13th 1941, the property as
listed in diary No.1, was handed over to D.I. Crighton
at Crime Branch Headquarters.

The three guns and ammunition have been submitted
to the Arms Identification Section for examination.

Reference to the .45 Colt Automatic No.330144 marked
United States Property, a check has been made with the
U.S.A. Consulate, U.S. Marine Corps and American Company
S.V.C. but no record of this gun can be found.

At 10.30 a.m. 13th August 1941 Commander Tsung Soong
accompanied by his adjutant Waung Sung Ching called at
Crime Branch Headquarters and requested the return of
their guns etc.

It was explained to Commander Tsung Soong that
enquiries had not yet been completed in regard to
the seizures, hence they could not be returned to him
meantime.

He appeared quite satisfied with the explanation
given him and stated that he would await further infor-
mation from the Police.

All the remaining property i.e. clothing etc was
returned to him.

John Crighton
D. I.

The 1st named stated that when arrested they were
proceeding to 9 Ung Yoeh Terrace, Yu Yuen Road where

When questioned as to the ownership of the seized
Fire Arms they stated that they were issued to them
by their regiment as follows (1) Tsung Soong - .45 Colt

firearms, ammunition and baggage to be detained at this

April 8, 1941.

Central Naval School of the Ministry of Navy,
Nanking Government - recruiting students.

With reference to the attached translation of an
article published in the Mainichi of April 1 to the effect
that the Central Naval School (Ministry of Navy, Nanking
Government), located at Kaochong-miao, Nantao, is recruiting
students, enquiries have been made with the following
result :-

Between March 1 and March 12, 1941, the Naval
Training office of the Central Naval School, Kiaochong-miao,
Nantao, recruited 184 students from Shanghai and principal
cities in Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Provinces. These
recruits are undergoing a training course which will cover
a period of six month, after which they will be attached
to Naval ships as 3rd class marines at $26 per month.

From April 1 to April 17, the Central Naval School
will recruit a third batch of cadets at Nanking, Soochow,
Hangchow and Shanghai. The recruiting office in Shanghai
is located in the premises of the school at Kaochong-miao,
Nantao.

Applicants must be between the ages 17 and 22, healthy
and have had junior middle school education. The preliminary
examination will be held between April 20 and 22 and the
final examination will be held from June 5 to 6, 1941.
The term will begin from July 1st.

Having passed the entrance examination, the recruits
will receive three years training in the school, during
which period they will be paid $12 per mensem with board
and lodging, academics, books etc. After graduating from
the school, they will be appointed naval officers at a
monthly pay ranging from $70 to $80.

1941年4月8日。

南京政府海军部中央海军学校 - 招收学生。

关于附件中译自4月1日《每日新闻》的一篇文章，该文称位于南市高昌庙的中央海军学校（南京政府海军部）正在招收学生，经查询，结果如下：-

1941年3月1日至3月12日期间，位于南市高昌庙的中央海军学校海军训练处，从上海及江苏、浙江、安徽各省主要城市招收了184名学生。这些新兵正在接受为期六个月的训练课程，之后将以每月26元的薪饷作为三等水兵隶属海军舰艇。

4月1日至4月17日，中央海军学校将在南京、苏州、杭州和上海招收第三批学员。上海的招生办事处设在南市高昌庙该校校址内。

申请者年龄须在17至22岁之间，身体健康，并具有初中学历。初试将于4月20日至22日举行，复试将于1941年6月5日至6日举行。学期将于7月1日开始。

通过入学考试的新兵将在该校接受三年训练，在此期间，每月发给12元薪饷，并提供食宿、教学、书籍等。毕业后，将被任命为海军军官，月薪在70至80元之间。
